about.title: About Bizflow
about.mission: Bizflow is a digital transformation platform designed specifically for traditional household businesses in Vietnam — especially construction material stores, grocery stores, and Group 1 & Group 2 businesses as defined by Decision 3389/QĐ-BTC (2025).
about.challenge: According to surveys, most household businesses still operate fully manually — using notebooks and Excel. They lack equipment (computers, receipt printers, barcode scanners) and budget for accountants. Bizflow was created to solve this problem.
